ageRules.message: Nigeria's Trade Information Portal lists used motor vehicles above 12 years from manufacture as prohibited, while its vehicle-import guide says less than 15 years. sourceNotes.name: Nigeria Trade Information Portal - importing motor vehicles
sourceNotes.note: The portal guide says only vehicles less than 15 years from manufacture are permitted. This conflicts with the portal's own prohibited-items list; do not use the guide alone to clear older used vehicles.

sourceNotes.name: Nigeria Trade Information Portal - prohibited items
sourceNotes.note: The official prohibition list says used HS 8703 vehicles above twelve years from manufacture are prohibited. This stricter line is the conservative planning gate pending a Customs clarification of the conflicting guide.

disclaimers: This is an estimate, not an official customs assessment.
The NTIP reference was checked22October2026 for two used-petrol HS codes. Levy/FOB notices disagree; GreenTax is not automatically valued. A full entered assessment replaces all reference charges.
Vehicle duty and levy components are intentionally stored in editable rule data because Nigeria vehicle policy packs can change.

The official trade portal conflicts on used-vehicle age: its prohibition list says above 12 years is prohibited, while its import guide says less than 15 years is permitted. The stricter 12-year line is used as a conservative planning gate; confirm the specific vehicle with Customs or a licensed clearing agent before purchase.

faqs.question: Can I calculate Nigeria if I only know the car price?
faqs.answer: Yes. The calculator treats purchase price as a FOB-style estimate, adds freight and marine insurance, then calculates on CIF. You can switch to FOB or CIF mode when you have cleaner shipping documents.

faqs.question: Why is there a Nigeria rule-pack warning?
faqs.answer: Choose the dated NTIP reference for used petrol passenger cars above1500cc, or enter your full Customs/broker assessment total and its source/date. The reference is not a current Customs bill and does not calculate GreenTax from an unconfirmed base.

copy.intro: Estimate a used petrol car import with the checked NTIP reference or your full Customs/broker assessment. Vehicle, freight, port, delivery and registration budgets are shown separately.
copy.hiddenCosts: Users often miss terminal delivery orders, scanning or examination fees, local registration, demurrage after free days, and FX spread between the quote date and clearing date.
